title: Trend Radar
subtitle: What is trending and making news in your market, ready to become content
intro: This page gathers, around the clock, what is trending and making news in Innov Builders's world. Each card comes with an angle ready to turn into a Reel. Approve the ones you want to produce, dismiss the ones that do not fit, and leave a comment anytime. It updates on its own.

voice.quem: Innov Builders, a Massachusetts residential construction and remodeling contractor led by its hands-on CEO, known for authentic jobsite storytelling and finish-quality craftsmanship for Greater Boston homeowners.
voice.eixo_viral: Real jobsite transformations and contractor insider knowledge that make homeowners trust the process and picture their own dream renovation.
voice.tom: Technical authority that inspires: confident, warm and educational, like an experienced builder who explains the why behind every choice and shows the real work behind a beautiful result.
voice.gancho_formula: Curiosity gap or bold truth about renovations + specific stakes (money, time, quality) + local relevance for Massachusetts homeowners.
voice.gancho_default: THIS IS WHY YOUR REMODEL COSTS MORE THAN YOU THINK

alvo.premium: high-end homeowners wanting a dream remodel done right
alvo.first_timers: first time renovators afraid of overpaying or delays

voice.angulo_corpo: Open with the fear or myth, then reveal the insider reason with a real jobsite example, then show the right way Innov does it and the payoff for the home.
voice.angulo_corpo_video: Hook on the transformation or the shocking detail, cut to the raw jobsite footage step by step, narrate the craftsmanship decision, land on the finished reveal.
voice.angulo_fecho: Position Innov as the trustworthy Massachusetts builder that delivers the result homeowners saw in the photos, on time and without headaches, then invite them to start their project.
